title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-05

ai_review.summary: High‑energy jam with a 17‑minute Dark Star into St Stephen and Lovelight, highlighted by stellar Pigpen playing, captured from an unknown source quality.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the expansive 17‑minute Dark Star that flows into St Stephen and then into another 17‑minute Lovelight, calling it an overlooked gem. Pig Pen’s performance is singled out as some of his best ever heard, indicating a powerful show despite no details on recording fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed 4‑star review praises the musical performance heavily while offering no insight into recording quality, leading to a solid but not outstanding overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on sound clarity, mix, or source type were provided by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Extended improvisational flow with seamless transitions from a long Dark Star into St Stephen and then into an equally lengthy Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Keys: Some of the best Pig Pen playing ever heard, according to reviewers.
